class.name: FoliageLayer
class.brief_description: A single paintable vegetation type inside a [FoliagePainter3D].
class.description: [FoliageLayer] describes one kind of vegetation that a [FoliagePainter3D]'s brush can paint: which [Mesh] to use, how much random scale/rotation/normal deviation to apply to each instance, how densely and how far apart the brush places them, and at what distance the layer should fade out (see the [member visibility_range_begin] group). This resource is pure configuration; it does not store any instance data itself. [FoliagePainter3D] paints and stores this layer's instances, spatially chunked into a grid of cells (see [member FoliagePainter3D.cell_size]) so that off-screen cells can be culled by the renderer independently. Use [FoliagePainter3D]'s brush tool, or its [method FoliagePainter3D.insert_instance] / [method FoliagePainter3D.remove_instance] / [method FoliagePainter3D.add_instance] methods, to add or remove instances.

members.member: Blends each instance's up axis between world up ([code]0.0[/code]) and the surface normal at the paint location ([code]1.0[/code]). Combined with [member random_tilt_degrees], this controls how much instances deviate from the surface normal.

If [code]false[/code], this layer's instances do not cast shadows (equivalent to setting [member GeometryInstance3D.cast_shadow] to [constant GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF] on the layer's internal [MultiMeshInstance3D]).

The approximate number of instances the brush attempts to place per paint stamp while this layer is active. Actual placement is also limited by [member min_instance_spacing] and by whether a valid surface is found under each sample point.

Equivalent to [member GeometryInstance3D.ignore_screen_space_shadows] for this layer's instances. Enable this to exclude dense, small foliage (e.g. grass) from screen-space contact shadows, which can otherwise be a relatively expensive effect to compute over thousands of small instances for little visual benefit.

The number of instances currently painted for this layer, summed across all of [FoliagePainter3D]'s cells. This is read-only and for informational display in the Inspector only; it is kept up to date automatically and is not saved with this resource.
A display name for this layer, shown in [FoliagePainter3D]'s brush layer list and used to name its internal [MultiMeshInstance3D].

Equivalent to [member GeometryInstance3D.lod_bias] for this layer's instances: values above [code]1.0[/code] make the mesh's LODs switch to a lower level of detail sooner, values below [code]1.0[/code] delay switching.
If set, overrides the material used to render this layer's instances (equivalent to [member GeometryInstance3D.material_override] on the layer's internal [MultiMeshInstance3D]).
The upper bound of the random uniform scale applied to each painted instance. See also [member min_scale].
The [Mesh] painted for this layer. The brush places nothing for a layer until this is set.
The minimum distance the brush enforces between two instances of this layer. Set to [code]0.0[/code] to allow instances to be placed arbitrarily close together.
The lower bound of the random uniform scale applied to each painted instance. See also [member max_scale].
If [code]true[/code], each painted instance receives a random rotation around its up axis.
The maximum random tilt, in degrees, applied on top of [member align_to_normal_amount] for natural-looking variation from instance to instance.
Equivalent to [member GeometryInstance3D.visibility_range_begin] for this layer's instances: the distance from the camera at which they start being visible (if greater than [code]0.0[/code]).
Equivalent to [member GeometryInstance3D.visibility_range_begin_margin] for this layer's instances.

Equivalent to [member GeometryInstance3D.visibility_range_end] for this layer's instances: the distance from the camera beyond which they stop being visible (if greater than [code]0.0[/code]). Use this to keep dense grass or small foliage from rendering far away.
Equivalent to [member GeometryInstance3D.visibility_range_end_margin] for this layer's instances.

Equivalent to [member GeometryInstance3D.visibility_range_fade_mode] for this layer's instances: whether and how they fade in/out across [member visibility_range_begin_margin] and [member visibility_range_end_margin] instead of popping.
